step_therapy_requirements: For Plaque Psoriasis, documentation of inadequate response to one of the following topical therapies is required: a corticosteroid, a vitamin D analog, tazarotene, calcineurin inhibitor, anthralin, or coal tar. Alternatively, contraindication to all of these topical therapies is also acceptable.
